newsitem.title: USA: Polymer says new line to help 1998 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Polymer says new line to help 1998 earnings.

text.p: Polymer Group Inc said on Thursday that it plans to install a large scale 4.2 meter wide SMS (spunbond/meltblown/spunbond) line at one of its North American facilities, boosting the company's overall capacity by more than 100 percent on completion.
The commercial start-up is scheduled for the fourth quarter 1997 and is expected to contribute to earnings beginning in 1998, the company said.

The company said the new line will combine conventional capabilities along with proprietary Polymer Group technology, giving the line the unique capability of running a wide range of polymers at extraordinarily high speeds.
